description: Look up a Ethereum transaction by hash: sender, recipient, value in ETH, nonce, gas limit, the 4-byte function selector and its block. Use to see what was sent or whether it exists; for success or failure and fees paid use eth_receipt, for emitted events eth_logs. Input is a 0x-prefixed 64-hex hash; an unknown hash returns 404, uncharged. Example: hash=0x9531467e03a57bbb5cd080439ac3b10c0cefed147282eb2ff709b02c897afcbf. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: eth_tx
title: Ethereum transaction
